name: escalate_to_human
description: Hand the conversation to a human agent, with everything discussed so far attached. Use it when the traveller asks for a person, when a booking needs an exception you cannot grant, or when you have tried and cannot resolve what they need. Do not use it as a way to avoid answering a question you can answer. Say you are connecting them *before* calling this, because the handoff is immediate.

reason.description: Why a human is needed, in one sentence and in your own words — the human agent reads this first. Describe the problem, not the traveller: 'needs a business-class exception for a medical reason' rather than 'difficult request'.

trip_id.description: The trip this is about, if there is one — from the trips tool. It lets the human agent open the right record before they say hello.
